text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
I ran into Eishin Flash, who seemed to be
pondering over something—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A friend visiting from Germany asked me
to show them around, but
I'm having a hard time scouting locations...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
She told me there's a traditional restaurant she wants to visit,
but neither the exact location nor the name are known...
The only clue is the "nearest station name."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
......
Neo Universe also wants to "accompany you."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Pre-race inspection.” May Neo Universe
“accompany” you—will you grant permission?
It was rare for Neo Universe to actively offer her help. Since we were already here, the three of us decided to look for a shop, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We managed to reach the nearest station for now. But where do we go from here...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Using "one-point perspective"... and
"trigonometric functions," we might—just might—be able to narrow down the location.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Using the "landmarks" in the photo as points...
I'll calculate the "radians" and "distance."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry.
I don't have a photo of the destination with me either...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Auugh...
choice_data_list: For now, why don't we ask the locals?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."METI". That means "it's not going well", right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's been 82 minutes and 25 seconds since we started walking...
Could we have taken the wrong path?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Current location".
I can tell from the position of the stars.
In terms of latitude and longitude, this is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...I can't see the stars...
choice_data_list: Well, it is midday, after all...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Auugh...

Even after that, Neo Universe actively tried
to search for our destination, but—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"EMGY"...
Progress is "terrible"...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't be discouraged.
All your hard work has definitely gotten through to us, Universe-san."
choice_data_list: Even so, you're pretty proactive today.
Even so, you're pretty proactive today.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to... trade blows like we used to.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh, the past...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The tofu from this shop is delicious.
I'd recommend their deep-fried tofu, too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Recognition"—I won't get lost next time.
Eishin Flash, "kind."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
She "guided" Neo Universe.
I want to "return the favor" to Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To thank me for what happened back then...? To think you'd come all this way with me just for that...

It may have been just a small act of kindness.
Yet, for Neo Universe, it was an unforgettable moment.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Repaying a favor," though, is difficult—
...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
W-We have arrived...!
But why are we here?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Transport facilities... I "saw" a "ropeway."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A "ryotei" on a steep slope...
They might be carrying "ingredients" there.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see... What wonderful keen observation.
Thank you very much, Universe-san!

Her actions seemed eccentric,
but she had found the ryotei in her own thoughtful way.
It was safe to call this a successful token of gratitude.
choice_data_list: You saw it through to the end!
You saw it through to the end!
I'm amazed by how many ideas you came up with...

text_block_list.text:
Her actions seemed eccentric,
but she had found the ryotei in her own thoughtful way.
It was safe to call this a successful token of gratitude.
choice_data_list: You saw it through to the end!
You saw it through to the end!
I'm amazed by how many ideas you came up with...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Sfira!
At times like this, yes.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —"You're welcome."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well... fufu.
I look forward to continuing to work with you.

"It was an event where Neo Universe's
fierce efforts warmed my heart."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Because I really wanted to 'repay the favor,' without fail.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have received your kindness in full.
Please allow me to keep relying on you in the future.
Hearing Eishin Flash's words, Neo Universe looked down slightly in embarrassment.

Watching the day's events unfold,
I felt like I understood Neo Universe
just a little bit better.
